name: problem
description: A problem that people or agents hold, stated as a claim.

aiGuidance.purpose: One problem in the SemanticOps method: a claim about what is wrong or missing, held by one or more personas (held-by), grouped into clusters (contains) and answered by remedies or epics (answers).
aiGuidance.extraction: Suggestions are drafted by agents; the human layer adopts by record fork. Link the holding persona with held-by; never write a persona name into the statement.
